name: fine-arts-studio-block-431
estimated: the south face's columns, windows, mullions, sills and heads and its roller doors, with a photograph as a reference; the stair tower's and the entrance canopy's glass, with a second photograph, of the east entrance, as a reference; the end walls standing 0.35 m in under the eave, the roof's slab and the fascia; and the faces no photograph shows, drawn plainly
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its photograph of the south face is taken from the car park at the lane's west end, about 6 m west of the building's west end and 8 m out from the line of its south face, looking north-east along it, through a lens of about 78 degrees across, its optical axis at bearing 8 degrees and its principal point solved (the photograph is the upper right of a wider frame); its camera is fitted to the south eave against the sky, the eave's east corner, the low box's east corner (the LiDAR's u 11.3) and four verticals, held near 1.6 m over the LiDAR's ground. A second photograph, of the east entrance, has no camera fitted: it is a reference for the glass of the stair tower and the canopy there

building.title: Fine Arts Studio Block 431 (431), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 431's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 431 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 3.06 m over the door's ground (33.09 m), 3 m over the provisional ground the frame was measured from (33.16 m, the median LiDAR ground within the outline's band, as the measured massing took it); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the block's long faces (bearing 252.6 deg), so z faces south-south-east (bearing 162.6 deg), to the lane and its car park, which the photograph looks along

light.note: estimated: the photograph is taken under broken cloud, the south face in soft light with no hard shadow. The viewer's sun stands to the south-south-east (160 deg round, 50 up), before the face, at an exposure of 0.55: the luma (p50) over the model's screen box 143 against the photograph's 150; of the face's panels under the middle windows halfway along it 144 against 149, but near the camera 214 against 168 and under the upper windows 216 against 168, where the photograph's face lies in a softer light than the viewer's sun gives

door.note: under the glass canopy before the east entrance, beside the glass stair tower (the campus map records no lobby or entrance in 431): u -26.5, w 1.0 in the building's frame ((26.5, 1.0) in the view frame). The LiDAR's ground within 1 m: 5 returns, p10/p50/p90 33.053/33.090/33.135 m (the canopy hides the ground under it from the LiDAR); the lane before the south face lies at 33.06 to 33.21
